name: working-with-llms
description: The Working With LLMs workflow: skills for writing a vision, writing GitHub issues, and mining PR reviews; a project-review agent that checks a repo's readiness for agentic work; and an /adopt-workflow command plus opt-in, per-repo soft enforcement that nudges you to write an issue before substantial work. The installable companion to the guide at llms.codebycarson.com/working-with-llms.
